# third-party/mattpocock — vendored reference copies

Faithful, unmodified copies of five skills from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) (MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE)), vendored for reference and single-file reuse. Retrieved 2026-08-06 from commit [`8b36d4f`](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/commit/8b36d4fb2635b3c21998dcd8144439c9e5ba7302).

| File | Upstream path |
|---|---|
| [claude-handoff.md](claude-handoff.md) | `skills/in-progress/claude-handoff/SKILL.md` (upstream also ships an `agents/openai.yaml`) |
| [handoff.md](handoff.md) | `skills/productivity/handoff/SKILL.md` |
| [grill-me.md](grill-me.md) | `skills/productivity/grill-me/SKILL.md` |
| [grilling.md](grilling.md) | `skills/productivity/grilling/SKILL.md` |
| [wayfinder.md](wayfinder.md) | `skills/engineering/wayfinder/SKILL.md` |

These are **not** part of the Open Science Skills plugin — not installed by it, not counted in the skill badges, not mirrored into `plugin/.skills/`. Install them from the source instead (`claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`, or `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills --skill=<name>`); the copies here are for reading, provenance, and dropping a single file into an agent harness that wants one. See [`RECOMMENDED.md`](../../RECOMMENDED.md) for why these five.
